infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AceTrack needs your GPS location to find tennis courts and nearby players to challenge.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AceTrack needs GPS location for live court navigation and radar matching.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AceTrack needs camera access to take your player profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AceTrack needs photo library access to upload your player card avatar.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: AceTrack needs read access to your Heart Rate and workout biometrics during tennis matches.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: AceTrack saves your tennis matches as official workouts in Apple Health.
